name: guitar-studio
description: 六弦工坊 · AI 吉他练习室（V3.0：Tone.js 音频内核 / 目录重构 / 多主题 / 中英日韩）

scripts.lint: node -e "const{readdirSync,statSync}=require('fs');const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');let bad=0;const walk=d=>{for(const f of readdirSync(d)){const p=d+'/'+f;if(statSync(p).isDirectory())walk(p);else if(f.endsWith('.js')){try{execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p])}catch(e){console.error(p,e.message);bad++}}}};['assets/js','server','test'].forEach(walk);process.exit(bad?1:0);console.log('lint ok');"
